newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries off lows, dlr recovers after U Mich.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries off lows, dlr recovers after U Mich.

text.p: *US Treasuries cut losses, dollar comes off lows after University of Michigan consumer sentiment consumer sentiment index registers 102.8 in August vs 107.1 in July. *U of Mich preliminary Aug current conditions 109.3 vs 114.0 final July. August expectations 98.5 vs. 102.6 final July.
